conversationalSummary.text: It’s TODAY and there’s no reliable window, mainly because the wind looks like it’s going to be pretty awkward for Meio da Baia (it may feel too soft without more push). I’d save the drive and, before committing to anything, do a quick check on the Surfline cams and MEO Beachcam for the lunch window—if they don’t look surprisingly cleaner than expected, it’s not worth chasing. Probably best to sit this one out unless the cams show a clear improvement.

best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 76 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 79/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at low tide can still make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia punchy.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; Meio da Baia may feel too soft without more push.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
